conditions.displayName: Cloud Run 5xx responses sustained above ~6 per 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="basecamper" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

documentation.content: Sustained 5xx responses from the basecamper Cloud Run service. Triage: RUNBOOK.md → Health & monitoring. Search logs by `requestId` from any failing response; `reportError()` entries group in Error Reporting. Usual suspects: OpenAI incident (`/api/chat`), DB connectivity, a bad deploy — roll back with `make rollback`.
